scope: Existing-hardware physical placement. Literature/code inspection only; no model, dataset, external payload, fitting, or simulator execution.

sources.title: BigMoMo: Efficient Inference of Large-Scale MoE with Speculative Decoding on Mobile Devices
sources.venue: Preprint, under review; no accepted venue verified
sources.github_status: No author-associated artifact verified; bounded name/topic searches saved. Unrelated name matches are not attributed.
sources.reading_depth: Latest full main text read; equations 3/4 and sections 3.2, 4.3, 4.4, 5.4.2 inspected in detail.

paper_facts.unit: Whole-expert Flash slots; output-row tiling belongs to VTCM staging.
paper_facts.demand: Actually Flash-loaded experts after pruning and DRAM residency filtering, per verification round.
paper_facts.objective: K=3 recent-round hyperedges; maximize anchor overlap; profiled contiguous-anchor read plus scattered outsiders. Apply maximum-positive cumulative read-time swap.
paper_facts.movement: Both experts must already be in shared DRAM; exchange writes preserve footprint and pause for critical reads.
paper_facts.address_scope: UFS/file offsets, not exposed chip/plane mapping.
paper_facts.reported_cost: 13.42 MiB relocation writes/output token; 15.06% fewer read requests versus offline coactivation.
paper_facts.phase_evidence: Nearby-round stability; five separate workloads. An explicit abrupt domain-transition amortization experiment was not located.

sources.inference: Direct threat to generic runtime co-loading/hypergraph/contiguity claims. IFP does not naturally load weights into DRAM, so its relocation source reads cannot be assumed free. Eq4 itself contains read benefit, not an explicit program/erase/wear subtraction; this does not establish that the paper's measured runtime excluded write interference.

sources.title: Paging the Experts: A Reproducible Characterization of Flash-Backed MoE Inference on iPhone
sources.artifact_status: Official paper-linked implementation and public result summaries; no weights downloaded.
sources.reading_depth: Full main text and claim-boundary appendices read; pinned README, packer, and positional reader inspected.

paper_facts.unit: One layer file, complete expert gate/up/down quantized tensors plus metadata, fixed stride aligned to 64 KiB.
paper_facts.objective: Byte-budgeted DRAM caching and optional prefetch; not learned physical chip placement.
paper_facts.counters: Logical expert bytes are distinguished from physical NAND reads; cold expert cache does not imply cold filesystem cache.
paper_facts.finding: 512 MiB LRU has zero demand hits on tested streams while random eviction has 18.8%; 576 MiB LRU has 38.58%.
paper_facts.semantics: Same-runtime cache/prefetch controls preserve sequences; cross-runtime/device sequence equivalence not established.
paper_facts.phase_evidence: Five recorded workloads and held-out prefetch cases, not online Flash reorganization.

code_facts.packer: Expert slices serialized consecutively to experts/layer-NNN.bin; padding fills fixed stride.
code_facts.physical_scope: File offsets only; no NAND chip/plane ownership API in inspected paths.

sources.inference: Strong measurement-boundary prior, not a physical declustering algorithm. Cache hit-rate improvements must not be relabeled in-place NAND-compute placement savings.

sources.title: FlashAccel: Leveraging High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) for High-Throughput LLM Inference
sources.artifact_status: Author-associated explanation slides, mostly AI-generated per README. Recursive tree has README and one slides PDF only; no simulator implementation verified.
sources.reading_depth: Full latest main text read, with detailed sections III-B, IV, V, VI and VII-D.

paper_facts.unit: Megapage weight chunks striped round-robin across megaplanes; next operator starts at the following megaplane.
paper_facts.native_constraint: A megaplane groups 32 planes at identical block/page offsets under shared commands.
paper_facts.objective: Active plane fraction and maximum-versus-average plane load; balances physical sensing/transfer.
paper_facts.dynamic_part: KV excess megapages copied to HBM and reads redirected; original HBF data remains.
paper_facts.mapping: Object/chunk physical indexes and read manifests; architectural SRAM/HBF/GPU integration.
paper_facts.phase_evidence: Static operator execution-order layout, active-request KV balancing. Coactivation-dependent expert masks not located.

sources.inference: Physical parallelism/plane striping and operator carry-over are prior. HBF architectural commands cannot be treated as existing AiF capabilities. Transfer the layout objective only after lowering to AiF's legal complete dense jobs and resource accounting.

sources.title: HBFSim: Fast and Faithful Simulation of High-Bandwidth Flash Under Real GPU Execution
sources.artifact_status: Official paper-linked simulator; source inspected, not built/run.
sources.reading_depth: Full text accessed; design, implementation, evaluation, related work and discussion read; introductory material skimmed. Pinned README and three placement/bank files inspected.

paper_facts.mechanism: PTX instrumentation injects modeled HBF completion at dependent consumption while preserving GPU asynchrony; optional bounded cache/backing file.
paper_facts.scope: Modeled HBF with real GPU execution, thermal/retention/refresh coupling.
paper_facts.validation: 0.152% measures an injected-delay increment, not absolute physical HBF latency. CD8P is an NVMe reference, not HBF.
paper_facts.moe: Measured deduplicated demand across three batch sizes; speculative prefetch test uses synthetic access stream and claims no timing gain.

code_facts.cache_policy: CLOCK/LRU/Belady over equal-size complete experts; no I/O in policy.
code_facts.layout: Canonical host manifest separates live CUDA addresses from frozen physical stack/module extents. UCIe bank layout maps LPA by modulo geometry; reduced geometry is marked scenario-specific.

sources.inference: Useful address-manifest/evaluation discipline, not a verified MoE coactivation chip-mapping algorithm. Fixed trace replay remains suitable for conditional placement cost if routes and numerical execution are held fixed; capacity/cache/migration policy changes require their own feedback model.

sources.title: HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs
sources.venue: RACS '26, November 17–20, 2026, Fukuoka; paper metadata. Conference is future relative to audit date.
sources.artifact_status: Official paper-linked simulator; mapping documentation inspected, not built/run.
sources.reading_depth: Full main text read; sections 3.3, 3.5, 4.1, 4.3–4.5 and limitations scrutinized. Pinned README and full mapping-organizations document read.

paper_facts.mechanism: Serving frontend emits transaction DAGs; resource calendars model host FTL, HBM and physical HBF planes.
paper_facts.placement: Page and extent mappings stripe consecutive pages; baseline block mapping serializes pages on one plane.
paper_facts.calibration: Scheduler, GPU operator and host link calibrated. HBF/HBM4 timing unavailable; 18 of 30 parameter groups assumptions.
paper_facts.moe_routes: Qwen3-235B routes synthetic uniform top8, with Zipf sensitivity; not real routing.
paper_facts.limitations: Short decode/prefill windows omit GC interference; physical HBF timing/endurance assumptions.

code_facts.fairness: Mapping-index comparisons need identical physical PPNs/planes or single-bank controls; striping gain is separate.
code_facts.migration: Live-page copies charged NAND to HBIO to HBM to HBIO to NAND; no free copyback. Programs split by cause and summed.

sources.inference: Direct prior to host-managed physical stripe/resource ledgers and costed migration. Not a validation source for AiF timing, native output contract, or real MoE coactivation gains.

covered_claims: Runtime co-loading hypergraph plus on-Flash expert reorganization
Logical whole-expert aligned packing plus cache/prefetch
Plane-aware striping and maximum-load-aware physical layout
Object-to-physical manifest and explicit copy/erase accounting
not_established_by_these_sources: Existing AiF complete-row native command lowering with no added contexts or operand features
Native GU-to-activation-to-private-down resource-DAG placement under real recorded routes
A positive, costed read-in-place migration result with no already-resident weight source
overall.warning: An untested combination is not automatically novel. Generic declustering expressiveness is also not, alone, a proof that a constrained systems contribution is impossible.
